findings.pen_geometry: Isaac Gym uses four pen assets per env, length 0.40/0.44/0.48/0.52 x scale. SuperDex used 0.40 x scale for all (mean 86% of IG length, min 77%; about 3/4 of episodes affected).
findings.termination: IG end-point termination uses one scalar for all envs: 0.52 x last env scale (about 0.15 m). SuperDex used 0.40 x own scale (about 0.116 m), so it terminated later than IG.
findings.fix: penlen=ig: per-env mesh length from the record point cloud, inertia recomputed from that mesh, termination with the IG scalar.

labels.note: Micro F1 excluding pen channel, against SDX resync labels re-collected with the correct pen length. f and calib are still the models fit on the wrong-length pairs. Control: on 0.40 pens old and new labels are identical (F1 1.0).

pen_end_estimate_error_cm_clean_pose.note: Mean per-coordinate L1 against the clean pose, 3 eval seeds. DAgger pose_l1 of about 2.1 cm includes a uniform +-4 cm box noise on the target. SDX at mu=1 with the pen fix.

integration_check: On records evalFA, tactile seen by the f student matches offline f output: P(seen|pred)=0.876, consistent with latency 0.2 and dropout 0.1.
